analisis: Suplemento alimenticio en cápsulas a base de aguaje, fenogreco y maca negra (triple acción). Es un nutracéutico para mujeres que buscan más volumen en glúteos y piernas sin subir de peso. Viene en un frasco negro brillante con tapa y base rosadas, de 60 cápsulas. Se toman 2 cápsulas al día con las comidas y el tratamiento completo es de 3 frascos (3 meses).
descripcion_visual_en: A cylindrical glossy black plastic supplement bottle with softly rounded shoulders, about twice as tall as it is wide, closed with a hot-pink ribbed screw cap that has the small white word 'VITALABH' repeated around its side. The bottle is wrapped in a glossy black label that ends in a solid bright pink band at the very bottom of the bottle. Label, from top to bottom: a small pink-and-white 'VITALABH' logo with a tiny stylized figure icon; the word 'AGUAJE' in very large bold white uppercase letters; below it 'COMPLEX' in bold white and '3 EN 1' in bold hot pink on the same line; a thin hot-pink strip with the small white text 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; the words 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' in bold italic hot-pink uppercase with a pink swoosh underline; a row of three small rounded boxes with pink outlines reading '200 mg AGUAJE', '400 mg FENOGRECO' and '200 mg MACA NEGRA', joined by white plus signs; and at the bottom '60 CÁPSULAS' in bold white next to tiny white text. Colors: glossy black body, hot pink cap, hot pink accents, white lettering. Ignore the hand and the video player bar visible in the product photo: use only the bottle.
